question: India’s border with Myanmar runs along the states of Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram and ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Provinces of India having normal lines with Myanmar are **Mizoram, Manipur, Nagaland and Arunachal Pradesh.**
 
• India and Myanmar share a 1,643 km unfenced line along** Arunachal Pradesh (520 km), Nagaland (215 km), Manipur (398 km), and Mizoram (510 km**) and grant a 'free development' system up to 16 km past the boundary.
 
• The line is** 1,643 kilometers **long and runs from the tripoint with China in the north to the tripoint with Bangladesh in the south.
